analysis: Absolute hidden burden, clinical adjusted (recorded ASA sensitivity)
analysis_role: ASA coding sensitivity for the primary exploratory association
outcome_definition: creatinine-defined KDIGO AKI through postoperative day 7
exposure: hidden AUC per anaesthesia-hour at MAP <65 mm Hg
population: all AKI-evaluable complete cases, including zero reference AUC
covariate_adjustment: age, sex, body mass index, ASA Physical Status >=3, emergency surgery, hypertension, diabetes, baseline creatinine, anaesthesia duration, and surgical department
causal_boundary: Exploratory association under counterfactual display emulation; not a causal effect of monitoring frequency
formula: aki ~ age10 + male + bmi5 + asa_high + emop + preop_htn + preop_dm + baseline_cr05 + duration_hr + C(department) + hidden_twa10

analysis: Absolute hidden burden, clinical plus reference burden (recorded ASA sensitivity)
analysis_role: ASA coding sensitivity beyond total reference burden
outcome_definition: creatinine-defined KDIGO AKI through postoperative day 7
exposure: hidden AUC per anaesthesia-hour at MAP <65 mm Hg
population: all AKI-evaluable complete cases, including zero reference AUC
reference_burden_adjustment: quadratic B-spline (3 df) of log(1 + reference AUC per anaesthesia-hour)
covariate_adjustment: age, sex, body mass index, ASA Physical Status >=3, emergency surgery, hypertension, diabetes, baseline creatinine, anaesthesia duration, and surgical department
causal_boundary: Exploratory association under counterfactual display emulation; not a causal effect of monitoring frequency
formula: aki ~ age10 + male + bmi5 + asa_high + emop + preop_htn + preop_dm + baseline_cr05 + duration_hr + C(department) + bs(log_true_twa, df=3, degree=2, include_intercept=False) + hidden_twa10
